newsitem.title: CANADA: World Wide to start Bolivia gold hunt.
newsitem.headline: World Wide to start Bolivia gold hunt.

text.p: World Wide Minerals Ltd said on Tuesday that it entered into a preliminary agreement to explore for gold in Bolivia.
World Wide said it had a preliminary agreement with Compania Limitada de Oro de Yi Chuan de Bolivia.
The company said the deal gave it a five-year option to acquire up to an 85 percent interest in the Yi Chuan gold property, 240 kilometres north of La Paz.
World Wide can maintain its option by making payments totaling US$7 million to the owners and performing exploration work worth US$2.5 million over two years.
